name: smoke-dissolve
title: Smoke Dissolve
description: A ring of smoke expands from the center of the frame and the incoming scene materializes out of it. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .smd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A moody, atmospheric reveal where the next scene should emerge from the middle of the frame.
Slow chapter breaks with a lot of runtime.
avoidWhen: Fast cuts or upbeat promos: the smoke needs time to read.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Multiplier for the smoke’s own drift.
